pitfalls: Relying on ORM cascade without setting DB ON DELETE when the task requires it.
mappingNotes: Compare your ORM/schema code with the Equivalent SQL panel. The task gate introspects Postgres — only real tables/FKs count.
solution:
from sqlalchemy import String, Integer, Numeric, Boolean, ForeignKey, UniqueConstraint, create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Mapped, mapped_column, relationship


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass

class LabCategory(Base):
    __tablename__ = "lab_categories"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(120))
    items: Mapped[list["LabItem"]] = relationship(
        back_populates="category", cascade="all, delete-orphan", passive_deletes=True, lazy="selectin"
    )


class LabItem(Base):
    __tablename__ = "lab_items"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    label: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(120))
    category_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("lab_categories.id", ondelete="CASCADE"))
    category: Mapped["LabCategory"] = relationship(back_populates="items")

engine = create_engine(DATABASE_URL)
Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
